guarantees: All original source lines remain in original order; existing callback/mutation/Task scheduling expressions and actor annotations are untouched.
No new body log, observer, timer, Task, await, subscription, scene/entity inspection, lazy hand read or forced redraw.
Recorder helper sits inside existing DEBUG class and forwards scalar fields through existing emit, without harnessEvent UIKit census. Root helper is DEBUG-only; Surface local and sites DEBUG-only.

limits: Read-only git apply --check and textual invariants only; no Swift parse/typecheck/build/device or actual source application.

Inserted scalar dictionary/string allocation and synchronous emit/file I/O consume time on the calling actor. Before/after spans include this overhead; marker time is not a perfect API entry timestamp.
Same-binary control and existing observation flags must be recorded by any eventual owner; a changed startup under instrumentation is not a root cause or fix.
Existing make marker occurs after applySync. Existing make-counter timestamp, if enabled, gives entry; no new host marker added.
A Surface task cancelled before its existing first guard emits no startup-load marker. Missing markers must be reported as incomplete, not zero work.
